data.body: Plan-review remediation for blocking finding f7f949e4c01c917e3 and advisory f607dd457c67f9209: added an automated tokenize.COMMENT backstop with explicit parent/final ranges for all 16 allowlisted ordinary-comment blocks. After subtracting only those ranges, every remaining comment token must match in both column and bytes; the existing AST normalization covers exactly 20 allowlisted owner docstrings, and directive/shebang physical-line equality remains separate. Split compound acceptance criteria into individually observable checks. Replaced the local make verify requirement with worktree-venv make lint plus make typecheck and focused tests; Gerrit Verified CI is now the explicit full-suite pre-merge gate per operator direction. The oracle reads committed HEAD^ and HEAD trees.
